context:
Goal: degen lanes merge again, starting with PR 528.
Problem (rule): PR 528 is reviewed and its CI is running, but degen main's last milestone-proof run is red, and your item 404 lift covered #509 only. A lift needs your words typed in runner 9's chat; a page pick does not reach its check.
Based on (read): the red run, 41747042457, is the by-hand Mac run of 11-04 at the old sha 73f66dbfc (runner 9, 10:37 CST Nov 8).
Based on (ruling): item 404 a (06:18 CST Nov 8): one lift, for #509 only; every other degen merge waits on a green milestone-proof run.
Departs from: main, where only #509 merged over the red run — adds a second one-time lift.
Meanwhile: PR 528 waits, and PR 526 and PR 527 cannot pass their lane lints until it lands. On a, type the lift for PR 528 in runner 9's chat (link below).

options.gain: The pin bump lands now, and PR 526 and PR 527 can pass their lane lints.
options.how: Type a one-time lift for PR 528 in runner 9's chat; it merges PR 528 once over the red run.
options.label: Lift for PR 528 only
options.lose: One more merge over an unrelated red Mac run.

options.gain: A real green clears every degen merge.
options.how: Runner 9 dispatches milestone-proof on degen main 76c7e57.
options.label: Run the Mac tests on main's head
options.lose: GitHub Mac minutes are spent, and the last three runs failed or were cancelled.

options.gain: No merge over a red run.
